name: Limitless Nexus
description: Clean Limitless provider branch built one source at a time for maintainable anime, animation, drama, movie, and TV coverage.

scrapers.name: Re:ANIME
scrapers.description: Anime provider using TMDB/IMDb to MAL/AniList identity mapping and Re:ANIME's structured Flix API. Uses direct FlixCloud MKV downloads, preserves both HD-2 mirrors, and identifies shared SUB+DUB files as Dual Audio + Subs while keeping SUB-only and DUB-only files correctly labeled.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus port based on maintained Re:ANIME direct-download behavior

scrapers.name: WCO
scrapers.description: Production WCO provider with title-aware movies and Season 0 specials, Episode 0 and fractional-special fallbacks, separate Dub/Sub sources, season and range matching, real mirror handling, safer movie/special audio classification, and mirror labels only when an explicit alternate server/CDN branch is present.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus WCO production merge

scrapers.name: WCO Domain Test
scrapers.description: Temporary isolated WCO frontend fallback test. v0.5.3 keeps corrected movie/special audio labels and adds direct /anime series-slug discovery when an isolated movie or Season 0 frontend returns no series match.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus WCO domain test
